purpose: prove before validation-outcome access that the complete frozen training-unit support of a predeclared training-resampling process is disjoint from the declared validation-row support

definition.training_support: the complete unit roster from which every admissible v1 process refit resamples
definition.validation_support: a metadata-only roster containing exactly one declared validation row ID column
definition.process_wide_consequence: because every process refit samples only from the frozen training roster, zero support overlap implies zero training-validation row overlap for every possible refit draw from that frozen process
